verdict.rationale: Databricks documents OpenSharing as its built-in data sharing platform for sharing data and AI assets with users outside the organization, even if they don't use Databricks. Its Marketplace also documents dataset listings that customers can discover and connect to from their workspace. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that shares are live and zero-copy (no replication or export pipeline), cross-account mechanics detail, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
